question.text: The payoff graph for a long futures position shows:

answer.text: Unlimited profit potential when price rises and unlimited loss when price falls — a linear payoff
Limited profit with unlimited loss potential
Limited loss with unlimited profit potential
Fixed profit regardless of price movement

explanation.text: The Logic: Long and short futures positions have linear, symmetric payoffs. For a long position, profit = (Settlement price - Entry price) x Lot size, generating profits when prices rise and losses when prices fall, with no upper or lower bound. The Trap: Limited loss with unlimited profit describes a long option position, not a futures position. Note: Both long and short futures positions have unlimited profit and unlimited loss potential, in contrast to options.
